routes.sofria: the source's own Sofria; read with extract_sofria
routes.usj: our USJ (the only form published for the edition); read with extract_usj
routes.usx: the source's USX; read with usx_to_usj.py / usx_to_sofria.mjs (tools/verse-text)
routes.helloao: helloAO chapter JSON through tools/verse-text's converter, then extract_usj
routes.plain: plain verse text; read with tools/verse-text's plain reader
routes.pkf: a PKF collection; reading route not settled yet
